description: A generated plan that is not valid YAML at all (a syntax error, not a calendar-invalid timestamp like c528-invalid-timestamp-reflector-plan) is never handed to use(inline) to diagnose: there is no YAML dump-and-reparse round trip left to produce raw text for it to parse, so it fails the reflector's own iteration directly as parse_failed, with no generated child node. PyYAML's own message is third-party text, masked by the conformance harness's own message-shape catalogue (tests/conformance/README.md) wherever it lands: the top-level error, prime.plan_it.meta.error and prime.plan_it.meta.iterations.0.error.
